title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Goldman Sachs acquires NEOS for $2.25B, adding $1B BTC income ETF (BTCI) to lineup — closes Q1 2027.
Fidelity files with SEC to stake 100% of $898M FETH ETF, quarterly cash payouts to shareholders.
Sept Fed hike odds ~65% after muted Jul CPI (+3.4% YoY, +0.1% MoM) — PPI (Jul) due today 08:30 ET.
